programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Friendship One
programme.desc: Voyager recovers a long-lost space probe which has caused terrible radiation damage on a distant planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Natural Law
programme.desc: Seven and Chakotay stumble upon a race of primitive humanoids isolated from technological progress by an energy barrier.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Homestead
programme.desc: Neelix is faced with the decision of a lifetime when Voyager locates a tribe of exiled Talaxians on a distant asteroid.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Renaissance Man
programme.desc: Janeway is held hostage by aliens who force the Doctor to help them steal Voyager’s warp core.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Endgame Part 1
programme.desc: Voyager’s quest to return home is aided by a visitor from the future – Admiral Kathryn Janeway.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Endgame Part 2
programme.desc: Janeway risks Voyager’s shortcut home in order to destroy the Borg and save millions of lives.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Caretaker, del 1
programme.desc: När de söker en saknad officer, sveps kommendör Kathryn Janeway och besättningen på rymdkryssaren Voyager 70 000 ljusår hemifrån.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Caretaker, del 2
programme.desc: Voyagers besättning iscensätter ett riskfyllt räddningsuppdrag av två officerare som har fastnat i en underjordisk stad som står inför en katastrof.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Parrallax
programme.desc: Tensions rise between the merged Starfleet and Maquis crews when the ship becomes trapped inside a star that's collapsed upon itself.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Time And Again
programme.desc: When Paris and Janeway are sent back in time, they must decide whether to violate the Prime Directive by warning residents of a planet facing annihilation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Phage
programme.desc: Neelix faces certain death when an alien race stricken by a devastating plague "harvests" his lungs.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: The Cloud
programme.desc: The crew discovers that a nebula is not what it seems, and Paris invites his fellow officers to share a little "R&R" in his holodeck program.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Eye Of The Needle
programme.desc: The discovery of a wormhole in deep space raises the crew's hopes of finding a shortcut home.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Ex Post Facto

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Emanations
programme.desc: Kim confronts life and death issues when he's held against his will by an alien race.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Prime Factors

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Encountering a group of Vulcan pilgrims on a mission to explore their emotions, T'Pol is enticed to attempt some of their technique with a handsome and charming pilgrim, Tolaris.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer and his crew encounter a group of alien hunters upon a rogue planet that has broken out of its orbit.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The entire Enterprise crew is knocked unconscious by a plundering Ferengi crew through a Trojan horse gas canister, leaving the ship to be easily ransacked.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.desc: T'Pol relates a tale of the Vulcans real First Contact when she claims that a relative of hers crash-landed in Carbon Creek, Pennsylvania in 1957, mingled with the townsfolk, and rescued workers in a mining accident.

programme.desc: When Enterprise is struck by a soon-to-detonate weapon and lodges in the ship's hull, Reed must deactivate it, but his subsequent injury and a group of encroaching Romulans bent on destruction force Archer think creatively to save the crew and ship.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise
programme.desc: Archer feels compelled to help a rustic alien colony that finds their rich resources constantly dwindling due to the Klingons' pillaging ways.

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Star Trek: Enterprise

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av killarna lägger näsan i… smink, och frågan är hur det kommer påverka spelet för hans del framöver. Ytterligare ett känt ansikte gör entré, redo att hämnas på sina motståndare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellets after ski bjuder på både bråk och kaos. Svartsjukan bubblar över för ett av paren och den stela stämningen sprider sig på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En kille ska checka ut men, planer smids bakom stängda dörrar och allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Dags för en sjukt het vecka där gästerna har förvandlats till sjuksköterskor och brandmän. En ny patient checkar in för att få sitt brända hjärta omhändertaget och en gäst börjar tvivla på sin pakt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Känslorna fortsätter svalla på hotellet och spelet är i full gång. En tjej tvingas checka ut och planer smids inför den kommande parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Säsongens första parceremoni går till historien och efterspelet är inte nådigt. Allianser börja sakta men säkert luckras upp och hur pakterna kommer se ut framöver är högst oklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Ny vecka i Paradiset och frågan är om hotellet är en himmel eller ett helvete? Hemligheter avslöjas och två nya gäster checkar in för att röra om ordentligt i grytan.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av de nya gästerna visar sig ha ett förflutet med en av killarna, till hans partners stora förtret. Ett svek uppdagas som vänder upp och ner på hela hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skärselden fortsätter att locka fler offer och ett oväntat erbjudande dyker upp. Hur långt är man beredd att gå för att ta sig vidare? Dessutom har det blivit dags för säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det uppdagas att flera på hotellet har blivit erbjudna samma sak, utan varandras vetskap, och stämningen blir minst sagt kylig. Parceremonin närmar sig, men innan dess ska en av tjejerna checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Parceremonin tvingar ytterligare en tjej att checka ut och frågan är, kan lojalitet leda till attraktion? Åtminstone verkar det fungera så på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skolveckan är i full gång och det vankas prov i ordkunskap. Kärlek blomstrar mellan ett par av eleverna och Frökens Favorit checkar in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vem målade Mona-Lisa? Och är Kuwait ett land eller en frukt? Nya prövningar väntar eleverna när en immunitet står på spel. Dessutom rör en dagsfest upp starka känslor – precis innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En lojal partner är A och O på Paradise Hotel men, en back up är minst lika viktigt. Ytterligare en kille tvingas lämna hotellet och den efterföljande festen får svartsjuka att blossa upp.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Cirkusen har anlänt till Paradiset men, faror lurar i manegen. En galen mördarclown är lös på hotellet och när som helst kan någon bli mördad och tvingas checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Festen får svartsjukan att frodas och teorierna om vem som är hotellets mördarclown går isär. Två spådamer checkar in för att hjälpa till att lösa mysteriet men, vad är egentligen den röda tråden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Pandoras Ask kommer aldrig lägligt men kanske extra olägligt just ikväll. En allians ”behind the scenes” blir allt starkare, men kommer spådamerna att lyssna på den alliansen eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är aldrig kul när en annan tjej vill ha ens kille och speciellt inte på Paradise Hotel. Hemliga allianser riskerar att avslöjas när parceremonin tvingar alla att visa sina rätta färger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Är det ostvecka på hotellet? Dags för lederhosen och dirndl när gästerna hamnat i Alperna. Ett välbekant ansikte checkar in, redo att ge allt och bara tänka på sig själv.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: Temptation Island USA
programme.desc: Paren försöker hålla sig lugna när de ser sina partners bjuda singlar på dejter, men känslorna och svartsjukan är påtaglig.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bio-Attack
programme.desc: When more than 700 Oregonians contracted food poisoning from a unique strain of salmonella in 1984, investigators uncovered a secret plot to influence local elections.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Catch 22
programme.desc: In 1996, 54-year-old Gayle Isleib was ambushed in her Manchester, Connecticut driveway and shot to death. Police had to determine whether obsessive love was the motive for her murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: When the Dust Settled
programme.desc: Soon after organizing a workers' strike, a union official is executed in his home. Neither his wife nor anyone in the neighborhood hear any gunshots. It takes a forensic sound test, an electron microscope and a nightgown to explain why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, a serial bomber targets a judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traffic Violations
programme.desc: The body of a young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car. Police were especially concerned when they realized the victim had come to them for protection just two weeks earlier after a road rage incident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Cinderella Story
programme.desc: The victim had been sexually assaulted and stabbed to death on the beach. A pair of men's tennis shoes was discovered near her body. Police were sure that if they found the man who fit the shoes, they would also find the man who committed the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: In 1996, police received a call from Darlie Routier telling them of her two sons' murders. The police found the killer by analyzing blood spatter, doing behavioral profiling and analyzing Darlie's 911 call.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Shot in the Dark
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kill'igraphy
programme.desc: This examination of the role autopsies play in murder investigations focuses on the suspicious death of Virginia Ridley. Police charge her mentally unstable husband with murder, but a medical examiner discovers that she died of natural causes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Knot for Everyone
programme.desc: The bodies of several women are found on a remote hill in California. The police get a break when a prostitute escapes and is able to identify her attacker and his automobile.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Big Chill
programme.desc: For years, a woman suffered from what appeared to be the unpleasant side effects of lithium, a drug prescribed to treat bipolar disorder. When she died, investigators had to determine if her death was due to natural causes, suicide or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ghost in the Machine
programme.desc: While investigating the apparent overdose suicide of Reverend Bill Guthrie's wife, detectives recover incriminating files from Bill's computer and learn of his infidelity.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Touching Recollection
programme.desc: The investigation into the kidnapping and rape of an 18-year-old Ohio woman is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dessert Served Cold
programme.desc: A man dies in his home after a long history of heart disease. A few weeks after the funeral, rumors surface that the death was no accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Screen Pass
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl went missing from her Colorado home. The only evidence the kidnapper left behind was three fingerprints on a window screen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grounds for Indictment
programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sip of Sins
programme.desc: In the 1980s, a trio of unsolved murders occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas. Later, a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with far more than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Partners in Crime
programme.desc: In a 1992 murder case, the autopsy of a cremated body turns up telltale clues of foul play.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 70s and 80s a gang of thugs wreaked havoc on the island of Puerto Rico. Organized, experienced and deadly they seemed beyond the reach of the law.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A criminal who kills a police officer wages war on society. In 1987 such a criminal vanished after shooting two Boston officers, one fatally. He had a history of violence against cops and the protection of a group of outlaws.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission

programme.sub-title: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 2
programme.desc: In this episode, hear first hand testimonials and dialogue from the incredible men who walked on the moon. Incredible footage and photos give a unique and beautiful experience of their data collection process and journey home.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.
programme.sub-title: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity
programme.desc: This film features unexpected historical insights, cutting-edge science and exciting new experiments. From Einstein's Relativity to quantum mechanics, host Jim Al-Khalili explores one of the most extraordinary phenomena in our universe.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie prøver at reparere sit forhold til sin bror, Spencer, Mischa konfronterer Perez Hilton, der mobbede hende før i tiden. Gnisten mellem Audrina og Justin ulmer stadig, men Justin har også fået øje på en anden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får en chokerende oplysning om Justin Bobby, der tvinger hende til at genoverveje sine motiver. Bølgerne går højt, da Spencer og Heidi overvejer deres forhold til Brody. Og Brandon Thomas holder et poolparty for sin mor.
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterer Justin efter han nægter at have kysset hende. Brody klager over forholdet til sin far, Caitlyn og hans tidligere bedste ven Spencer. Da de forsøger at udvide forretningen, bliver Spencer og Heidees forhold sat på en prøve.
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gruppen tager til Vegas for at se Brody optræde som dj, og Justin føler sig fanget mellem Audrina og Stephanie. Der udbryder naturbrande i Malibu og Kaitlyn frygter for Brodys liv, da han bliver i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn skal forholde sig til naturbranden i Malibu. Audrina træffer en svær beslutning om Justin. Mischa skal til audition til en stor filmrolle og Heidi vil genoplive sin popsangerinde-karriere.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Rygterne flyver efter en skadaløs hændelse, der involverer Brody og Stephanie. Audrina får et chok, da Justin tager en flot date med til middagen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Are We Exclusive?
programme.desc: Kaitlynn & Brodys 'A-liste-galla skaber splid i gruppen, da hun ekskluderer visse medlemmer. Audrina overrasker alle ved at genantænde et forhold til en gammel flamme. Spencer chokerer Heidi med en overdådig overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: This Hangover Better Be Expensive
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn har stadig problemer i forholdet, da de besøger en fertilitetslæge. Heidi og Spencer forbereder sig på at forny deres løfter med konkurrerende polterabends. Brandon har svært ved at definere sit nye forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Brody Gets Away with So Much
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynns ægteskab er i uføre da rygterne svirrer om deres kærlighedsliv. Efter at have lovet eksklusivitet begynder Brandon at tvivle på sit forhold. Audrina lægger sin skilsmisse bag sig og indleder en ny forretningssatsning.
programme.sub-title: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Of Course We're Married
programme.desc: Spencer konfronterer Brody med hans ægteskabsstatus og sandheden afsløres. Brandon træffer en endelig beslutning om sit forhold til Ashley. Whitney deler en følelsesladet nyhed med Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad jonglerer sin designeruddannelse, et krævende praktikantophold og en uforudsigelig bofælle, der saboterer hendes jobevent, så hun lærer hurtigt, at alt er større i L.A., inklusive hendes problemer.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Da Heidi får et interview til et 'drømmejob', der får hende til at overveje at droppe skolen, indser Lauren, at hun og Heidi er på vej i forskellige retninger.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue sender Lauren væk på et ærinde til New York, og da hun vender tilbage til L.A. venter der en stor overraskelse fra hendes fortid. Heidi indser, at arbejdet som festarrangør ikke er en stor fest.

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: The Hills: Jason's Birthday
programme.desc: Lauren skynder sig hjem fra et Teen Vogue-event for at være sammen med Jason på hans fødselsdag, men aftenen går ikke som forventet. Audrina beder om Heidis råd til hendes seneste date med model/skuespiller Danny.

programme.title: The Hills: Boyfriends and Work Don't Mix
programme.desc: Jason bliver en stor distraktion i Laurens professionelle og akademiske liv. Heidi får endelig sin store chance for at arbejde på natklubberne, men den kunne ikke være kommet på et værre tidspunkt.

programme.title: The Hills: Somebody Always Has to Cry
programme.desc: Det er slængets første ferie i L.A., men ikke alle får, hvad de har ønsket sig. Lauren får svært ved at få et nytårskys, da hun får et uventet opkald fra en gammel flamme.

programme.title: The Hills: You Can't Just Be With Me?
programme.desc: Jason vil gøre Laurens 20 års fødselsdag speciel, men da hun lyver om at arbejde med mandlige modeller til en opgave for Teen Vogue, bliver deres forhold sat på prøve.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Just Be With Me?

programme.title: The Hills: Love is Not a Maybe Thing
programme.desc: Heidi beslutter omsider, at hun har haft nok drama med Jordan. Lauren og Jason tænker på at tage tingene videre til det næste niveau.
programme.sub-title: Love is Not a Maybe Thing

programme.title: The Hills: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Da Laurens hårde arbejde til modeugen i L.A. fører til en alle tiders karrieremulighed, er hun splittet mellem sit job og sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Da en ikke inviteret Audrina dukker op til Heidis fødselsdag, finder hun ud af, at Heidi ikke er parat til at tilgive og glemme. Lauren vil fokusere på sit arbejde, men falder for den charmerende nye fyr i sit liv, Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?
programme.desc: Audrina fortæller Heidi om Spencers utroskab, men Heidi tvivler - indtil hun ser det selv. Lauren tvivler stadig på, om hun er parat til et forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption
programme.desc: Heidi holder en pause fra Spencer, men savner ham mere end hun havde håbet på. Lauren skal planlægge en middag for Teen Vogue, men ryger i baggrunden til fordel for superpraktikanten Emily fra New York.

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen
programme.desc: Da Lauren fortæller Heidi, hvad hun virkelig mener om Spencer, må Heidi vælge mellem sin bedste veninde og sin kæreste.

programme.title: The Hills: With Friends Like These...
programme.desc: Lauren indser, at hun ikke kan stole på sine bedste venner, efter Heidi fører Jen og Brody sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Enough Is Enough
programme.desc: Spencer beder Heidi flytte ind med ham, men Heidi ved ikke, hvad hun skal gøre, eller hvordan hun skal fortælle det til sin bofælle Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: New Year, New Friends
programme.desc: Laurens 21. Fødselsdag er fuld af overraskelser, da Heidi og Audrina holder en fest for hende. Jen prøver at slutte fred med Lauren.

programme.title: The Hills: Apology Not Accepted
programme.desc: Lauren fylder 21 og Heidi har store planer for fødselsdagsfesten. Men inden festen beslutter Heidi, det er tid til at fortælle Lauren om Spencers idé om at flytte sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: Everyone Falls
programme.desc: Med udsigt til et nyt job, falder Whitney over sin største mulighed med Teen Vogue. Spencer går for vidt, da han presser Heidi til at forlade Lauren og flytte ind med ham.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Love, Next Love
programme.desc: 10 reality-kendisser ankommer til paradis for at finde deres næste kærlighed, velvidende at deres ekser vil spolere festen. Vil deres ekser komme på tværs af deres næste forhold eller blive det?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Serving Revenge
programme.desc: En overraskelse i Hemmelighedshullet giver Mark og Elena nyttige oplysninger om deres forhold. En ny eks kan ikke beslutte sig, om de medvirker for at finde kærlighed eller for at tage hævn. En eks sendes hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Put a Crush on You
programme.desc: Et spil 'telefon' fører til et opgør mellem Aubrey og Devin. En male-fest kører af sporet. Og den første date-pris udddeles.
programme.sub-title: I Put a Crush on You

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight
programme.desc: Cameron er fanget mellem sin eks og sin næste. Et par kan ikke blive enige om, hvorvidt de stadig er et par. En eks bliver sendt hjem.
programme.sub-title: Cam You Feel the Love Tonight

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6

programme.sub-title: This is Episode 5 But Let's Call It 6

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Mother of All Secrets
programme.desc: En ny eks og et besøg fra mor sætter en kæp i hjulet for et spirende forhold. Marie kæmper med at være en 'sekser'. Singlerne slår sig sammen for at sende en eks hjem, der forhindrer en ven fra at finde sin næste partner.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Exes Haunt These Fields
programme.desc: En eks ankommer på det værst mulige tidspunkt for at ødelægge et nyt forhold mellem en single og deres anden eks. Mark pifter tingene op med Aubrey. Billy is smaskforelsket i Lexi. En kærlighedsdate uddeles.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Coffey Run
programme.desc: Cameron skal i retten for forbrydelser begået mod hans ekser. Mark og Aubrey skal forholde sig til en uventet eks. Ens eks bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: I Want It That Way
programme.desc: Aubrey forsøger at blæse med mel i munden hvad angår hendes forhold til Mark og Coffey. Cameron kan ikke lade Ariana komme videre. Cirkus kommer til byen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue
programme.desc: Mechies nye forhold bliver sat på prøve, da en ny eks ankommer til huset. SInglerne lærer, at deres handlinger har konsekvenser ved en eliminering. Et hemmeligt forhold afsløres.
programme.sub-title: Roses Are Red, Exes Make You Blue

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Thruple Trouble
programme.desc: Aurbrey og Marks forhold når bunden. Devins nye kæreste sender Marie i torvene. Den sidste date udloves og en uventet gæst forstyrrer et par.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Two for One Deal
programme.desc: Coffey ender midt i Mark og Aubreys brud. Mechie er splittet mellem sin eks og hans nye kæreste, hvilket gør Ariana anspændt. To ekser bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Show Me the Receipts
programme.desc: Nogle kendte og ukendte ansigter vender tilbage for at ryste op i tingene i huset. En løgnedetektortest tvinger nogle af singlerne til at vedstå, at de er nogle rodehoveder.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: The Final Crush
programme.desc: Huset skal forholde sig til resultatet af deres løgnedetektortest. Singlerne skal træffe den ultimative beslutning. Tager de hjem med deres deres eks, næste kæreste eller alene?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion
programme.desc: Singlerne og ekserne mødes for første gang siden den sidste ceremoni. Værterne Ashley Iaconetti og Jared Haibon fortæller os, hvilke par stadig er i hvedebrødsfasen, hvem der har slået op og hvem der har fundet sammen med deres eks igen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: War of Words
programme.desc: 'Ex on the Beach' er tilbage med otte singler, som håber at finde kærligheden på Bali, men i stedet erklærer Fatima og Nicole krig. Marty bliver betaget af Fatima, og Che og Max kan lide hinanden, men holder det, når eksene kommer?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: A Geordie Reunion
programme.desc: Jagten på kærlighed fortsætter, men problemer opstår, da Chloe fra 'Geordie Shore' afslører sine følelser for Marty. Jordan bliver aggressiv over for alle, og striden mellem Nicole og Fatima når et dramatisk klimaks.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Clash Of The Titans

programme.desc: De stærkeste par i huset bliver angrebet, da folk begynder at stille spørgsmålstegn ved deres stærke bånd. Michael ryster huset, da han prøver at ødelægge flere forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Bae-trayl
programme.desc: En harmløs leg bliver enden på et par. Frustrationerne vokser mellem par, der knytter sig for meget til hinanden og singler, der har svært ved at skabe kontakt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Jelly AF
programme.desc: Der bliver kaos i huset, da Kareems tiltrækning af Zoe får Alivia til at bryde ud i gråd. Alles nerver er på højkant, da pigerne vælger at følge en strategi til parceremonien.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Don't Come at Me Crazy
programme.desc: Jada bliver rasende, da Uche angriber hende for at lægge an på Clinton. To 'on-off'-par finder sammen igen. Pigernes familier afslører pinlige oplysninger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Sinking Relation-ships
programme.desc: Nurys kan ikke klare, at Malcolm og Diandra finder sammen. Huset er splittet mellem par, der nægter at splitte op, og singler, der har svært ved at knytte bånd.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tra Cray
programme.desc: Kareem og Alexis presses til bristepunktet, da Alivia og Keith udforsker, om de er et perfekt par. Ekser kommer med afsløringer, inklusive en eks, der allerede ved besked.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One
programme.desc: Vært Terrence J giver os et eksklusivt kig på denne sæsons medvirkende i AYTO og afslører, hvorfor de 22 singler er elendige til forhold.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: MTV Teen Mom
programme.desc: Oplev de dramatiske øjeblikke, når de unge mødre tackler hverdagens udfordringer eller oplever uforglemmelige øjeblikke. Det er non-stop drama hele dagen, hver dag.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: En dedikeret detektiv, spillet af Al Pacino, står over for en seriemorder, der udfordrer ham med et dødeligt spil kaldet Hangman.

programme.title: Relatos Salvajes
programme.desc: Hvad sker der, hvis man som offer for utroskab, parkeringsbøder eller en fyreseddel nægter at vende den anden kind til, men i stedet giver efter for sin impulsive vrede og tager kampen op?

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: En ung idealistisk advokat tager en sag om en fattig familie, hvis søn bliver nægtet hjælp af et stort forsikringsselskab og dør, og afslører forsikringssvindel for milliarder af dollar.

programme.title: Wings Of The Dove
programme.desc: Da en smuk ung jetsetkvinde må vælge mellem et liv med privilegier og fattigdom, bliver hun venner med en arving, hvis tragiske hemmelighed tilbyder en uimodståelig, men farlig, løsning på dilemmaet i denne fængslende historie om forbudt kærlighed.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Baseret på Richard Yates' bestseller følger denne fængslende og gribende historie om et lidenskabeligt, ungt par i forstads-Connecticut, som bestemmer sig for at risikere alt og følge deres drømme.

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: Den Oscar®-vindende publikumsfavorit om en mand, der søger efter et tilhørssted. Filmatiseret af bestsellerromanen, John Irvings stærke lektion om livet, kærlighed og hjemmet fik ros af kritikere og biografgæster over alt.

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom er en elskelig indadvendt mand, hvis emotionelle bagage har afholdt ham fra at udforske livet. Efter flere års ensomhed inviterer han Bianca, en ven han har mødt på internettet. Han introducerer Bianca for sin bror, Gus og hans kone, Karen.

programme.title: What Happened To Monday
programme.desc: I en verden, hvor overbefolkning har tvunget statsmagter til at indføre en drastisk etbarnspolitik, lever syv søstre i skjul. Søstrene skiftes til at antage én fælles identitet og færdes kun ude på skift, men en dag vender søsteren Monday ikke hjem.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: Ledsaget af sin bror Kurt (Van Damme), ankommer den amerikanske kickboxing-mester Eric Sloane (Dennis Alexio) til Thailand for at besejre de Østlige krigere i deres egen sport. Hans modstander: nådesløse fighter og Thai-mester, Tong Po.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Daniel Radcliffe kæmper mod naturens brutale kræfter og sit eget sind, da han forsøger at overleve i Bolivias nådesløse jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Remorse
programme.desc: A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Betrayed
programme.desc: On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When a bank teller arrived at her parent's home the gunmen were already there. The robbers held her family hostage and forced her to empty a bank vault. If she didn't comply she could lose everyone she loved.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When gangs go to war, they don't care who gets in the way. In 1988 an innocent man was gunned down near Cleveland, Ohio, a victim of a deadly initiation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drømme om et legat ødelægges, da hendes lærer, fru Tingle, med urette beskylder hende for at snyde. Da hun er desperat for at bevise sin uskyld, lægger Leigh Ann planer, der skal lære fru Tingle en lektie.

programme.title: Tommy Boy
programme.desc: Tommy har fået sit diplom og et job hos Callahan Auto Parts. Men familieforetagendet begynder at gå nedad bakke, og Tommy kører af sted med sin fars højre hånd, en dumsmart talknuser.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon spiller Tracy Flick, en handlekraftig elev, der vil være elevrådsformand på Carver High. Den populære lærer Jim McAllister (Broderick) vil afspore Tracys besatte overpræstation ved at rekruttere en oppositionskandidat.

programme.title: Swingers: Swingers
programme.desc: I denne morsomme indie-komedieklassiker, der startede karrieren for et enestående sæt skuespillere, sætter to venner sig for at omdanne moderne dating fra Los Angeles til Las Vegas.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: I den tro at de er ved at styrte ned, fortæller Emma alle sine hemmeligheder til en flot, men vildfremmed mand om bord på et fly. Det vil sige, hun troede, at han var fremmed… Filmen er baseret på bestsellerromanen af samme navn fra Sophie Kinsella.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: Ernest Goes to School
programme.desc: Jim Varneys tilbagevendende tumpede karakter Ernest P. Worrell vender tilbage i denne film som en pedel, der prøver at komme igennem high school. Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Den muntre, romantiske komedie Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en vred tandlæge fra Manhattan, der udvikler en uønsket evne til at se afdøde mennesker.

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Jimmy Savile
programme.desc: Jimmy Savile: From national treasure to one of the UK's most notorious sex offenders: this is the story of how the revelation of Jimmy Savile's crimes left the UK reeling.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Lee Rigby
programme.desc: In broad daylight on a busy Woolwich street on 22nd May 2013, serving soldier Fusilier Lee Rigby was attacked and murdered by Islamic extremists Michael Adebolajo and Michael Adebowale.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Rose West
programme.desc: With her husband Fred, Rose West brutally murdered ten girls between 1973 and 1979, making her one of the most high profile serial killers in the UK.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Marchioness Disaster
programme.desc: The story of the Marchioness; a pleasure boat that collided with dredger Bowbelle and sank within minutes resulting in the loss of 51 lives.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Clare Wood
programme.desc: In April 2007, Clare Wood met George Appleton on a dating website and they embarked on a relationship together. Unbeknownst to her, Appleton was a criminal with a severe history of violence against women.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Philpotts
programme.desc: When six children died in a house fire in Allenton, Derby in May 2012 it shocked the nation. Parents Mick and Mairead Philpott were charged with the murders. We uncover the reasons behind the arson attack on their own home.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Rolf Harris
programme.desc: Rolf Harris became famous for his artwork and music, even painting a portrait of the Queen for the jubilee. But it all came crumbling down in August 2013 when he was accused of 12 assaults on girls as young as eight years old between 1968 and 1986.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: April Jones
programme.desc: The hunt for five year old April Jones was the largest missing persons search in UK police history when she vanished in October 2012. But on October 6th a local man, Mark Bridger, was charged with her disappearance.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Dale Cregan
programme.desc: It's 2012 and drug dealer Dale Cregan murders police officers Nicola Hughes and Fiona Bone. Dermot Murnaghan investigates.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Angus Sinclair
programme.desc: Angus Sinclair, called Scotland's worst serial killer, is linked to the 1977 murders of two girls in Edinburgh.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Moors Murders
programme.desc: An investigation into the Moors Murderers, Myra Hindley and Ian Brady, with interviews with the family of Keith Bennett.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Suzy Lamplugh
programme.desc: A look at the case of estate agent Suzy Lamplugh, who showed a client around a house in Fulham in July 1986 and was never seen again. Dermot Murnaghan hosts.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Wrongly Released
programme.desc: This special episode shines a light on criminals who have been brought to justice for one crime only to be released to commit further terrible acts.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Rochdale Groomers
programme.desc: Rochdale Groomers: Documentary examining the sex abuse scandal which occurred in the North of England and appeared to go undetected for quite some time.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Joanne Dennehy
programme.desc: Dermot Murnaghan returns to uncover the truth behind the horrific crimes of Peterborough serial killer Joanna Dennehy.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Keith Blakelock
programme.desc: In 1985, PC Keith Blakelock was murdered during a riot on a housing estate in London, triggered after a black woman died of heart failure during a house search. Nobody has been brought to justice for his murder, despite three investigations.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Peter Tobin
programme.desc: Peter Tobin is one of the most notorious serial killers in the UK. From 1991–2006 he raped and murdered three young girls; Dinah McNicol, Vicky Hamilton and Angelika Kluk. Yet even prior to these horrific murders he had a history of violence.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: John Sweeney
programme.desc: John Sweeney brutally murdered two of his girlfriends, dismembered their bodies and dumped them in canals. In a macabre twist, he hid clues in his abstract paintings, and five other girlfriends of his are currently still missing.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Manchester
programme.desc: The series returns to take a closer look at the most horrific crimes ever committed on British soil, starting with the May 2017 Manchester Arena bombing.
